selfReview.type: AI own-locale direct Japanese semantic comparison and continuous Khmer teaching-prose review
selfReview.method: Read complete Japanese packet and translate every paragraph, heading, lesson field, prompt, option, specific rationale and full reading directly. Compare all meaning with Japanese, then read connected Khmer teaching prose, metadata and case/question in order. Check uncertainty, negation, measurement conditions, observed facts versus causes, actor/recipient and clinical limits. Verify source hash and fixed fields after final prose edits, together with own prior targets/reviews/profile bytes.
semanticChecks: Vital signs defined as information about life activity, including temperature and pulse. Measured value accompanies time, body site, instrument/method and known circumstances, with exact value/units where given and no guessed conditions. Recipient must understand when and under what conditions data were obtained.

Axilla/ear/forehead and devices may differ. Different site/method values are not treated as a same-condition change. Original records and each condition retained. Difference of conditions does not authorize ignoring higher value or the person’s illness/discomfort.

Vital signs are combined with person’s statements, observed condition and usual-state differences. Fatigue statement and measured data are both necessary. One non-high value does not prove whole health normal. Unchecked items explicitly separate from items confirmed without abnormality.

Breathing/pulse/blood pressure may vary with activity and physical/mental state; blood-pressure posture also relevant. Known immediately-postactivity context helps interpretation but does not establish cause. Neither activity nor age is asserted as proven cause. Observed changes and unknowns remain distinct.

Measurement follows device instructions, person-specific confirmed support, facility procedure and own assigned scope. Forehead devices require model-specific use conditions. No independent fever threshold, repeat-measurement time/count or treatment is derived from this teaching text. Unclear method or judgment is checked explicitly with assigned nursing staff or the appropriate stated professional.

Concerning changes reported to facility-designated recipient with value, conditions, person’s complaint, observations and unchecked items. High urgency means immediately seek assistance and follow facility emergency procedure rather than prioritize completing the record. Known facts may be conveyed before cause/diagnosis is known.

Teaching example preserves08:00axillary versus15:30forehead using a different device after return from activity, person’s fatigue statement and unconfirmed pulse/breathing. No fever/cause/whole-health conclusion from the two values alone. Distinct full question reading additionally retains another care worker as later measurer and the incomplete note stating only that the new value is higher. No actual temperatures, units, diagnoses or extra procedure instructions invented.

All four options and four specific reasons retain their exact diagnostic/causal/omission mistakes or correct reporting distinctions. CorrectIndex2 unchanged. Full reading translated entirely, not summarized or replaced by the lesson’s related but different example. Two objectives and lesson context complete. Art caption only states worker talking/recording and visible blood-pressure cuff on the arm, without inferring technique or outcome. Source has no figure-caption keys. Target contains onlyday176; no empty-day177–182 content or control changes.
